create_token_classification_params: create a TokenClassificationParams instance with custom learning rate and batch size for NER training
configure_token_classification_model: configure a TokenClassificationParams to use roberta-base model with fp16 mixed precision
set_early_stopping_params: set early stopping patience and threshold on TokenClassificationParams to prevent overfitting
configure_hub_push_params: configure TokenClassificationParams to push the trained model to the Hugging Face hub
customize_token_columns: customize the tokens_column and tags_column on TokenClassificationParams for a custom dataset schema
